data.gender_notes: Hinze is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German 'hini' meaning 'bright' or 'shining one'. In medieval Europe, this name was often given to children born during a solar eclipse or a bright star appearance, signifying hope and renewal. The name Hinze carries the meaning “Bright, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hinze usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
